dietsetup:handbook-body:
Your diet controls how food contributes satiety and nutrition. Only categories with positive capacity count toward your nutrition health bonus; a zero-capacity category need not be maintained.

Ordinary food keeps vanilla spoilage. Explicit freshness/spoilage rules can change that response. Food that would give your body nothing is left uneaten. When a full stomach can take only a small part of a mouthful, it tells you so. Harmful and Nourishing are ratings; neither label itself deals damage or heals you. Consequences must be separately authored.

Race bindings must be configured by the server administrator. Use /dietdiag to check your diet, /dietfood held or /dietfood target for ingredient facts, and /dietfood last for the last measured consumption. Bowl and pie outer-item ratings cannot summarize mixed ingredients.
